title: Hardened browser security and pinned dependencies
summary: ReconIQ now sends a strict browser security policy on every page and API response, keeps uploaded data out of caches, and installs only verified, audited dependency versions.

changes.title: Browser security headers and content security policy
changes.description: Every response now carries a first-party-only Content-Security-Policy plus X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, X-Frame-Options and Permissions-Policy. Scripts and styles can only load from ReconIQ itself, the app cannot be framed by other sites, and the few inline styles were moved into the stylesheet so the policy is enforced rather than advisory.

changes.title: Uploaded data stays out of caches and docs stay private in production
changes.description: API responses that carry broker or insurer data are marked no-store. Setting RECONIQ_ENV=production turns off the interactive API documentation page and adds the HTTPS-only headers; local development is unchanged.

changes.title: Verified, audited dependency versions
changes.description: Python dependencies are pinned with cryptographic hashes compiled from requirements.in, continuous integration audits them for known vulnerabilities on every run, GitHub Actions are pinned to exact commits, and Dependabot proposes updates as reviewable pull requests.

title: A transparent quality and incident review
summary: A public, read-only place to review the automated test catalogue, high-level steps, scripts, recorded outcomes, impacts, findings, and incident status.

changes.title: Quality & incidents tab
changes.description: Review unit, ingestion, reconciliation regression, API integration, and release-history scenarios with their source test names, steps, expected results, and impacts. The page separates planted demo exceptions from software defects and operational incidents.

changes.title: Recorded test result and section preferences
changes.description: See the latest recorded local pytest result, warning, timestamp, and performance caveat. Show or hide review sections with browser-local preferences; AI guidance is opt-in and explicitly not connected.

changes.title: Direct access for reviewers
changes.description: Open the page directly with /#quality. The public, read-only quality endpoint does not create or alter a reconciliation session.

title: A home for product updates
summary: See what has changed in ReconIQ, with a clear version number and a release history everyone can read.

changes.title: What's New tab
changes.description: Explore the latest features and previous releases without uploading files or running a reconciliation. Share a direct link using /#whats-new.

changes.title: Versioned release history
changes.description: Every release now includes a version, publication date and plain-language notes. The current app version is also visible in the navigation.

changes.title: Check updates without losing your place
changes.description: Move between What's New and Reconciliation while keeping your loaded files, column mappings, tolerances, results and exception filters.

title: The first ReconIQ prototype
summary: A local-first workspace for comparing broker policy registers with insurer statements and turning differences into actionable exceptions.

changes.title: CSV, Excel and PDF imports
changes.description: Load a broker register and multiple insurer statements, including PDF statements with or without a table grid. Review automatically detected columns and adjust the mapping before reconciling.

changes.title: Policy, premium and commission reconciliation
changes.description: Match policy numbers, review probable matches and set your own premium, commission and date tolerances. Differences are classified across 16 exception types and prioritised by severity.

changes.title: An actionable exception workspace
changes.description: See reconciliation KPIs and financial exposure, search and filter exceptions, and open a side-by-side comparison with a recommended next action.

changes.title: Excel and CSV exports
changes.description: Download an exception list as CSV or a three-sheet Excel workbook containing exceptions, a summary and matched policy pairs.

changes.title: One-click synthetic demo
changes.description: Try 40 broker policy lines and three insurer statements with 18 planted exceptions. Session data stays in memory and is discarded when the server stops.
